artifacts.text:
**Pitfall:** Hydrating lease facts (task/workspace/git dir/base SHA/observed execution) from requester- or worker-supplied fields, or fabricating a "default" lease on resolver miss — a forged or stale claim then binds the durable push target and policy credentials to lineage the server never observed.

**Negative oracle:** Invoke the factory with (a) no lease, (b) a lease whose requester/plan/task mismatches the binding, or (c) a worker record lacking exit-0 + confirmed cleanup + execution ID. Every case must return no factory and materialize no credentials; any produced factory, synthesized lineage, or default activation fails the row.
